the HF cycle is an authentic morphogenetical process that depends on a dynamic progression of stem cell lineage restriction.

1) the HF stem cell pool contains precursors with multipotent and restricted contribution; 2) the HF renewal cycle is an authentic morphogenetically process; 3) the HF renewal process involves the formation of a transient pool of precursors; 4) the position of the precursor relative to the dermis and the progressive restriction of their dispersion are crucial factors for the fate of HF lineages.
the HF renewal is an authentic morphogenesis that is characterized by a progressive segregation of the HF stem cells and their progeny.

the renewal of the hair follicle, which is an organ with an important regenerative capacity.
the renewal of hair follicles.
